findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which significantly delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a modification before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause stating that invoices are payable Net 90, this creates a significant delay in payment, so I propose updating the agreement to make invoices payable Net 30. Best regards,
